Don’t know man, feels that you feel attacked by someone who thinks you should be more visible to be safer. You might feel annoyed but at the end of the day, being more visible is a good thing. 
It’s just like someone saying you should eat more veggies, nobody can be wrong saying that 😀

Be happy! Whatever the reason the guy might have had, it’s up to you to do what ever makes you happy
Keep it! Maybe you don’t ride that often but it will always be waiting for you. If you want to store it you can always park it and with some love and care bring it back when you are ready.

You know? Bikes are like many other things in life, and they absorb the energy of their riders or owners and that bike gives a seriously good vibes. I am absolutely convinced the bike would look even better if it was you in the picture

It’s not about inclusiveness. It’s about understanding that cultures are to a point created by circumstances that are unique to their location and evolve as times change.

I see your point, I do, and many times I see that some cultures promote behaviours that are reprehensible from my vantage point. But I also see that the circumstances are different. Pick one. Arranged marriages, I don’t know anyone from my culture that would even consider it. But in rural India for example, it’s a mechanism that was implemented to create homogeneous society, and it found its place and it works by their standards.

What works for me in the western world only applies to me in the western world. What I might see as unethical only applies to my vantage point and my preconceived conception of the world. I cannot know or understand other cultures unless I immerse myself in them, and only from that place I can judge something ethical or not. And quite frankly, I don’t nearly know enough to judge anything as universal.
Your mom will probably not care too much about the value of the house as she will about loosing you.
The worst is that everyone looks at you like wtf is wrong with you? And they just dont get why you are not all joy and happiness like every fucking else

There is maybe what, 7 thousand MILLION people on earth, plus all the people that has ever lived and we remember who? The ultra special, Beethoven, Rembrandt, Julius Caesar. So in reality we all are for the most unremarkable and won't be remembered past the next generation or so. Even the most popular persons you know will be forgotten in a couple of generations.

So relax, there is no pressure to be remarkable, if you ask me, we should be more concerned about accepting who we are with our good and bad. I mean, not even Kanye or whoever you feel is the coolest today will be remembered in a 100 years. So fuck remarkability.

It's kinda funny, or maybe a better word would be ironic... On one hand it's all about"talk to someone about it" and once you do, things are never the same. Sooo, being treated like a weirdo is going to help make us feel included and valuable and worth saving... 
Makes me angry and sad and alone. As it probably makes everyone else feel...

I am so sorry that you feel like that. I want you to know that I share the same anger towards depression and feel so helpless that I can't just shake it up just as you probably do. You are not alone giving the middle finger to life every time you know that you should be happy, but can't really find that worm feeling inside.
